text: Working on a Playdate walking sim. Got to 30fps with endless mountain ranges on a 16bit system. Not bad. Started messing with adding a sun and expanding camera options. FPS TANKS. I bonked this thing for like… 12 hours trying to optimize anything to get framerate back. I go back in history and load up fresh copies and work forward trying various things until I merge a branch back in that I’ve verified doesn’t wreck my fps and the main is now back in doodoo framerate land. Not possible. Turns out a little bit of code on checking how many film rolls I had slipped in with that merge and it was polling every frame. lol Well now it’s back to blazing fast 30fps again and I get to keep all my fun fancy things.

text:
we do silly impulse things

"QUAK" https://mombotro.itch.io/quak About a month ago, as I was watching my daily perusal of baby chicken, duck, and turkey videos, I chanced upon one where the cameraperson had their other hand placed firmly at the bottom of the screen like it was an FPS. My wife pointed this out, saying it would make for a fun game concept. I immediately thought of DOOM. Name? Quake? Nah. QUAK. Now we HAD to do it. My wife is incredible. She got to work right away using Claude Code to come up with basic gameplay in Godot engine. I playtested the builds. She added sprites and artwork. I contributed voiceover. She got the sound effects from somewhere. My face inspired the one you see at the bottom-center of the screen. Lots of touch-ups and bug fixes later, QUAK is released and ready to play!

My wife is incredible. She got to work right away using Claude Code to come up with basic gameplay in Godot engine. I playtested the builds. She added sprites and artwork. I contributed voiceover.
